text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's solutions and discover parts of the system they do not usually work on. In addition, regular reviews help maintain a high level of team quality, since everyone follows the same standards and gives helpful feedback. Although code reviews take extra time, they are a valuable investment that improves both the product and the team.
